dataQuality.salesSource: ShopifyQL FROM sales grouped by product_variant_sku and product_title.
dataQuality.salesBasis: Gross sales, discounts, sales reversals, net sales and quantities are taken directly from ShopifyQL. They are not reconstructed from order line totals.
dataQuality.unassignedSkuBasis: Product sales rows with a blank product_variant_sku are retained in financial and quantity totals as unassigned SKU sales. They are excluded from the unique SKU count and SKU-level ranking; no SKU code is invented.
dataQuality.quantityBasis: Quantity ordered is the original quantity. Net items sold is after reversals. Reversed quantity is the quantity removed through refunds, returns, cancellations or order edits; Shopify may report it as a negative value.
dataQuality.skuCountBasis: Unique SKU count is the number of distinct non-empty product_variant_sku values with ordered or net item activity. It is not a unit count or order count.
dataQuality.periodBasis: Sales metrics follow Shopify sales-event reporting for the selected date range. Adjustments can be attributed to the date they occur, which may differ from filtering orders only by their creation date.
dataQuality.productGrouping: The report counts variant SKUs. A product-level Shopify report can combine multiple variants, so product totals and SKU totals are not always directly comparable.
dataQuality.costBasis: Gross margin uses the current Shopify unit cost where available, multiplied by net items sold. Historical unit costs are not reconstructed.
dataQuality.inventoryBasis: Available inventory is not currently synchronized; it is shown as unavailable rather than zero.
dataQuality.concentrationBasis: The full assigned-SKU catalog is ranked by actual net sales. No fixed 80/20 distribution is assumed. Unassigned-SKU sales remain visible in total sales and are not attributed to a SKU.

notes: All sales metrics are sourced directly from ShopifyQL FROM sales, grouped by product variant SKU.
Distinct SKU counts are not unit counts or order counts.
Product sales rows without a variant SKU remain included in financial and quantity totals but are excluded from the unique SKU count and SKU-level ranking.
Sales reversals include refunds, returns, cancellations and order edits.
A product-level report may combine multiple variant SKUs.
No fixed 80/20 rule is assumed; the full SKU concentration curve is calculated from actual net sales.
Gross margin uses current unit cost where available, not historical unit costs.
Inventory availability is not currently synchronized.
